$comment: Tifinagh as standardised by IRCAM for Moroccan Amazigh: 33 letters, written left to right. Glyphs render with Noto Sans Tifinagh.
title: Tifinagh
tagline: The Amazigh alphabet, one shape at a time.

letters.name: ya
letters.story: A little open mouth saying “aaa”.

letters.name: yar
letters.story: A ring. Roll the r around it: rrr.

letters.name: yas
letters.story: The sun with a dot in its heart. Sun starts with s.

letters.name: yu
letters.story: Two little moons, one above the other: oo.

letters.name: yab
letters.story: A ball wearing a belt.

letters.name: yan
letters.story: A single nail standing straight up.

letters.name: yat
letters.story: A plus sign: it even looks like a t.

letters.name: yam
letters.story: A mouth wide open to the right, saying mmm.

letters.name: yal
letters.story: Two lines leaning on each other, like a lazy l.

letters.name: yi
letters.story: A little zigzag ladder, climbing up: iii.

letters.name: yad
letters.story: A pointed roof, like the top of a dar, a house.

letters.name: yaw
letters.story: A cup, or a well, ready to fill with water.

letters.name: yay
letters.story: A beak turned sideways, opening to say yes.

letters.name: yaj
letters.story: A column with a big cap and a big base.

letters.name: yah
letters.story: A hoop on a stick: h for hoop.

letters.name: yaz
letters.story: The free man, arms raised. It stands at the centre of the Amazigh flag.

letters.name: yaẓ
letters.sound: a heavy z, from deep in the mouth
letters.story: The free man with an extra bar across: a weightier z.

letters.name: yak
letters.story: It looks like a k, and it is one.

letters.name: yaf
letters.story: A little bridge standing on two feet.

letters.name: yag
letters.story: An hourglass, grains falling through: g.

letters.name: yaɣ
letters.sound: gh, like a French r, gargled softly
letters.story: A fork, or a wishbone: the gh of “Maghreb”.

letters.name: yax
letters.sound: kh, like the ch in Scottish “loch”
letters.story: An X with a tail, a little scratchy, like the sound.

letters.name: yaq
letters.sound: q, a k pushed far back in the throat
letters.story: A box with one corner sliced: a deep, hard q.

letters.name: yaḥ
letters.sound: a breathy h, like fogging a mirror
letters.story: A little walking leg, breathing out: ḥaaa.

letters.name: yaɛ
letters.sound: ɛ, the deep throat sound of Arabic ع
letters.story: A tiny stool. Squeeze the sound from your throat.

letters.name: yac
letters.story: A snail shell with its head peeking out: sh.

letters.name: yaḍ
letters.sound: a heavy d, tongue spread wide
letters.story: It looks like an E, but it is a heavy, dark d.

letters.name: yaṭ
letters.sound: a heavy t, tongue spread wide
letters.story: The heavy d with a plus in the middle: a heavy t.

letters.name: yaṣ
letters.story: The sun crossed by a stroke: a heavier s.

letters.name: yaṛ
letters.story: The ring with a little tail: a heavier r.

letters.name: yey
letters.sound: e, a soft short sound, like “the”
letters.story: Two dots with a line between them, very quiet.

letters.name: yagʷ
letters.story: The hourglass with a little cup on its shoulder: the lips round to say w.

letters.name: yakʷ
letters.story: The k with the same little cup: kw.

lessons.title: Circles and suns
lessons.intro: The round letters come first. Most of them are drawn with a single circle.

lessons.title: Sticks and crosses
lessons.intro: Straight lines now. With these, you can already read your first words.

lessons.title: Roofs and cups
lessons.intro: Shapes you know from everyday things: a roof, a cup, a beak.

lessons.title: The free man and friends
lessons.intro: The famous ⵣ, and the letters to say hello.

lessons.title: Sounds from the throat
lessons.intro: The sounds Darija and Tamazight share, deep and rich.

lessons.title: Heavy letters and last ones
lessons.intro: The weightier twins, the quiet e, and the rounded gʷ and kʷ.
